It was published on [[May 18]], [[2021]]. ==Publisher's summary== '''''A book dedicated to the first season of the successful hit live action series''''' '''The Mandalorian''', '''''streaming on Disney+, featuring character files, plots, settings, and behind-the-scenes content.''''' ''An in-depth look at the making of the hit show, exploring the adventures of the Mandalorian and the Child.
